gen-dafont-redux-outfit: Contemporary and spacious, Redux sprawls wide. Its heading has a soft, tilted-nib wobble in the stroke, while Outfit traces each letter like bent cable, one constant line with curves that stop short of closing.
gen-dafont-redux-roboto-slab: Contemporary, with generous spacing and big entrances. Redux does its best work with a faint thick-thin shift in its tall lowercase, while Roboto Slab holds a tight, structured texture where the middle of each line dominates.
gen-dafont-redux-satoshi: Generous tracking and a big visible entrance into every curve define Redux. Satoshi then brings a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed, cut with no brush-like swelling, which makes the pair feel friendly and level.
gen-dafont-redux-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws every glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe like a cut reed. Redux above it is taller and gently graded, so reading feels spacious.
gen-dafont-rounded-elegance-fs-alpino: Alpino stands tall and casual, its curve endings held well apart and its ascenders looking short. Rounded Elegance hums above it like neon tubing.
gen-dafont-rounded-elegance-fs-hind: Hind reads steady and businesslike, its lowercase nearly as large as its capitals. Rounded Elegance is best at warmth, with letters nearly overlapping and wide entrances, while Hind is best at a drawn-string steadiness whose c never curls inward.
gen-dafont-rounded-elegance-fs-public-sa: Warm, snug and friendly. Rounded Elegance keeps every stroke uniform from heavy to light, and Public Sans follows with a hefty lowercase and broad counters that keep things trustworthy.
gen-dafont-sansumi-fs-alpino: Casual and cozy, Alpino sets the tone with tall bodies and curve endings held well apart. Sansumi sits wide and flat above it, its rounds free of any tilting stress.
gen-dafont-sansumi-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, with tall bodies in every lowercase letter. Sansumi does its best with rounded, cord-like strokes and wide tracking, and the serif below does its best at looking steady and settled.
gen-dafont-sansumi-fs-fira-sans: Flat, wide and tidy. Sansumi spaces its letters like tape-measure ticks, and Fira Sans matches that flatness with a large x-height and wide-open s curves; try a slightly larger body size.
